question: Among all the players whose weight is under 130, how many of them preferred foot in attacking is left?
evidence: weight < 130; preferred foot in attacking refers to preferred_foot; preferred_foot = 'left';
clarification: Count every row, including repeated id values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.weight < 130 AND t2.preferred_foot = 'left'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.weight < 130 AND t2.preferred_foot = 'left'

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 130 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

d.request: Among all players whose weight is under 130, how many rows have a preferred foot in attacking (preferred_foot) of 'left', counting every row including repeated id values (i.e., without de-duplicating by id)?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 130 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

b.request: Count every joined row (Player_Attributes joined to Player on player_api_id) where Player.weight < 130 and Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'left', counting duplicate player rows rather than distinct players (COUNT(*) instead of COUNT(DISTINCT player id))
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 130 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
